mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ccds_scba_calibration (profile_id, pressure, full_time_sec, cyl_type, source, measured_at, gmt_create, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{profileId}, #{pressure}, #{fullTimeSec}, #{cylType}, #{source}, #{measuredAt}, #{gmtCreate}, #{gmtModified})
mapper.select: SELECT id, profile_id, pressure, full_time_sec, cyl_type, source, measured_at, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM ccds_scba_calibration WHERE profile_id = #{profileId} ORDER BY measured_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT c.id, c.profile_id, c.pressure, c.full_time_sec, c.cyl_type, c.source, c.measured_at, c.gmt_create, c.gmt_modified FROM ccds_scba_calibration c INNER JOIN ccds_profile p ON p.id = c.profile_id WHERE p.station_id = #{stationId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.measured_at DESC, c.id DESC
